reviews.title: Solid budget CPU for an AM4 build
reviews.comment:
This is a really good processor if you are building a budget-friendly gaming PC or upgrading an older AM4 setup. Installation was straightforward, and once everything was running, it handled normal use, browsing, gaming, and multitasking without any issues.

For the price, I think it gives you a lot of value. It may not be the newest or highest-end processor out there, but it is more than enough for a lot of people. If you are trying to get a PC running well without spending a ton, this is a solid choice. I would buy it again for a budget build.
reviews.author: Justin

reviews.title: Good, budget-friendly upgrade!
reviews.comment: Excellent upgrade for my buddy's old Ryzen 2600 setup! If you're building a PC from scratch, go with the 7000 series or later, so your motherboard has a few generations of upgradability, but if you're already on AM4 and don't have much to spend, this is a good upgrade from the lower 1000 and 2000 series chips!
